metadata.description: Sebastian Sulinski's personal Claude Code commands and agents

plugins.name: review
plugins.description: Critical-review commands — /scrutinise for deep forensic review of recent work, /plan-review for multi-agent grounded review of a plan file.

plugins.name: good-morning
plugins.description: Resume work from the previous session — load memory, lessons, config, and the project's prompt, then propose next steps.

plugins.name: call-it-a-day
plugins.description: End-of-session capture — record state so the next session resumes with no context loss.

plugins.name: interrogate
plugins.description: Exhaustively interrogate project requirements through questioning — never writes code.

plugins.name: deprecate-repo
plugins.description: Fully deprecate and archive a repository.

plugins.name: query-analysis
plugins.description: Read-only audit of Eloquent and query-builder usage in a Laravel repo — flags queries with measurable performance or memory improvements and writes findings to docs/analysis/.

plugins.name: release-manager
plugins.description: Agent that runs the full release workflow — changelog, semantic-version git tag, and GitHub release.

plugins.name: dead-code-purger
plugins.description: Agent that finds and safely removes dead code and unused dependencies — verified, categorised, and only after explicit approval.
